p: And Abba, i.e., Rav, whose first name was Abba, concedes to me,
with regard to a girl less than three years and one day old,
Since there is no … intercourse … her, … there is no … wedding canopy … her.
Since there is no legal significance to an act of intercourse with her, there is no legal significance to entering the wedding canopy with her.
A girl three years and one day old can be betrothed via sexual intercourse;
yavam had intercourse with her, he has acquired her; and
is liable on her account because
and … she renders ritually impure a man who has intercourse with her,
and if she experiences a menstrual discharge she renders ritually impure a man who has intercourse with her,
so that he renders impure the object upon which he lies like the upper one.

w.25: man who has intercourse with her

p: she is married to a priest she may partake of teruma.
one of those … unfit … had intercourse with her,
one of those who render women unfit for marrying a priest had intercourse with her,
